answer: The dune debit happens at intake, summit totals the burned amount, and fable anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 9 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. A farm thus pays the burn once for every alias on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. A 72 account operation therefore ties up 26 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
